common:generalComment.#text: Fiberglass is a common type of fiber-reinforced plastic using glass fiber. The fibers may be randomly arranged, flattened into a sheet, or woven into glass cloth. It is used principally as insulation and as a reinforcing agent in plastics. Fiberglass refers to the fine glass fibers created by spinning molten glass. It is one of the most predominant fibers used in the industry of reinforced polymer.
玻璃纤维是一种常见的使用玻璃纤维的纤维增强塑料。玻璃纤维可以随意排列、压平成片或编织成玻璃布。它主要用作绝缘材料和塑料的增强剂。玻璃纤维是指通过纺丝熔融玻璃产生的细玻璃纤维。它是增强聚合物行业中最常用的纤维之一。

common:generalComment.#text: Boric acid is a water-soluble white compound that occurs naturally. It consists of oxygen, boron, and hydrogen. It has antifungal and antimicrobial properties. It is usually encountered as colorless crystals or a white powder, that dissolves in water, and occurs in nature as the mineral sassolite. It is a weak acid with antiviral, antifungal, and antiseptic properties. It is soluble in water and does not have any characteristic odour.
硼酸是一种可溶于水的白色化合物，自然存在。它由氧、硼和氢组成。它具有抗真菌和抗微生物的特性。它通常以无色晶体或白色粉末的形式出现，可以溶于水，在自然界中以矿物萨索莱特的形式存在。它是一种具有抗病毒、抗真菌和防腐性质的弱酸。它可以溶于水，没有任何特征性的气味。
